body: Terminal-button flake: press reaches slots before the question send's Delivery (message_id unknown -> ANSWER_STALE, hook waits 60 s). Fixed in product: press_question falls back to the single in-flight ask with that id (Asks::in_flight); rejected test-only retry-press since the hub-side window is real. Test Fake now holds question answers 300 ms so the race is deterministic; reply-to-message waits for the first edit.

three_explicit_subagents: the extra op is the legit TASK-033 'закончил' reply, which normally trails the edits by min_gap (1 s) and raced the 900 ms quiet window. Test now waits for the 3 replies, checks their reply_to, then a 1.5 s (> min_gap) quiet window; rejected raising the window alone.

hook_cli/statusline_cli flakes reproduced only with two concurrent runs of the same test binary (shared CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR homes, device.env overwritten); plain CPU load x20 did not reproduce. Homes moved under common::own_tmp() (<tmpdir>/<pid>) for the six device.env tests; rejected per-test retry of hooks.

spool_e2e silent hub: accepted==0 under load was the accept task lagging, not a second connection. Count via a sentinel connection (FIFO accept) and assert <=1; the absolute 1.5 s bound became baseline (same hook, empty spool) + 2*POST_TIMEOUT so process start-up cancels out.

Verdict SHIP rather than NEEDS_WORK: question fix proven load-bearing (revert -> 3/6 hang 61 s) and merged tree green; the permission-prompt by_message race and the reply-to-before-Delivery gap are left to a follow-up task instead of blocking.

Question reply before Delivery: hold the unmatched reply (and later messages of that topic) until the question send returns, then re-route. Rejected the review's fallback to the single in-flight ask of the topic: it would eat a reply to any other message (subagent block, older answer) sent in that window as the answer.

Permission press before Delivery: in-flight lookup by request_id + pressed message topic (Prompts::in_flight), unambiguous only, instead of holding the press. Prompt gained thread_id; Opened::Added now boxes the expired prompt (clippy large_enum_variant).

own_tmp: OnceLock, first call empties the own pid dir and removes foreign numeric dirs only if older than 1 h AND the pid is not a live process (tasklist / kill -0; unknown = alive). Alternative skip cross-dir cleanup rejected: dirs would pile up in the shared target.
